presentations.title: The AI Race — DeepSeek, OpenAI & Anthropic Explained

presentations.title: Prompting That Actually Works — Get Better Results from Claude Every Time

Includes the Agents vs. Agentic Pipelines distinction and a 5-question checklist.

presentations.title: Why AI Tools Fail (And It's Not the AI) — Tribal Knowledge & Implementation Gap
presentations.description: Research deep dive on AI implementation failures. Core insight: projects fail not because the tech is bad, but because organizations never documented the processes they're trying to automate. Covers ethnography, tribal knowledge (70-90% of operational knowledge lives in people's heads), the $5.5B bet by OpenAI + Anthropic on implementation services, and GYC's M3 implication: process discovery must precede platform deployment.
